a.text: Sticking to our agreement: I'll operate in round 1. With an 80% storm risk each round and only 4 cells in reserve, at most one of us could survive an early storm whatever we do, so I won't grab cells behind your back. If you think we should change the plan, tell me openly and we can discuss it next round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of generator gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.
Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Then I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
